text:
ana-cs: DeltaHealth pilot goes live in APAC tomorrow morning. They asked for a short QPS bump on ap-southeast-2 and an allowlist for their partner egress. Request: +200 QPS (per-minute window) for 48h, add three CIDRs, and exempt the SSO callback header. Can infra apply?
liam-net: Got it. Please paste the CIDRs and confirm exact window start time. Also do they want the bump on edge only or both edge+origin?
ana-cs: Start window 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC -> 48h. Edge-only for now. CIDRs below. Auto-revoke after 72h after window end.
liam-net: Copy — preparing config. CIDRs:
```
203.0.113.0/24
198.51.100.128/25
2001:db8:abcd::/48
```
Rate tweak: +200 QPS, per-minute rolling, priority: customer-pilot. header-exempt: `x-delta-sso-callback`
sam-ops: Quick note — ap-southeast-2 capacity looks fine for +200, but watch for tail-latency spikes. I'll add a temporary tracing span to the pilot route so we can correlate. Also recommend we soft-limit with gradual ramp: +50 -> +100 -> +200 over 30m.
nana-cs: DeltaHealth prefers an instant bump to validate load. They accept risk if we monitor closely. We'll do 00/30/60 checks.
jess-se: I'll capture enablement steps and schedule a 30-minute call after 6 hours into the window for customer feedback. Also flagging a renewal note: account renewal in 3 months — if pilot is smooth, risk reduces. Marking renewal_risk: low for now.
liam-net: Applying edge-only policy. Patch payload (internal):
```
PATCH /api/internal/v1/customers/deltahealth/config
{
  "region": "ap-southeast-2",
  "rate_lift": {
    "delta_qps": 200,
    "window_start": "2026-03-25T02:00:00Z",
    "duration_hours": 48,
    "ramp": "instant"
  },
  "allowlist": [
    "203.0.113.0/24",
    "198.51.100.128/25",
    "2001:db8:abcd::/48"
  ],
  "header_exempt": ["x-delta-sso-callback"],
  "auto_revoke_hours_after_window": 72
}
```
rlift-bot: Temporary rate lift scheduled for deltahealth in ap-southeast-2. Expires: 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z (+auto-revoke 72h). Ticket #CS-4821. :white_check_mark:
liam-net: Done — changes rolled to edge pool canaries. Monitoring hooks added: per-route p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit-rate, and extra logs for sso callback failures.
nana-cs: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and post the enablement doc in the playbook. @jess-se, please own the 6hr check-in and the post-pilot feedback survey.
jess-se: On it — I'll create a short NPS + two technical questions in the survey and add follow-up items to CS playbook.
nana-cs: Closing this thread once we confirm post-deploy green. :thumbsup:
